This Agreement is made on _____ day of ______, 20, between [Company Name], located at [Company Address] ("Company"), and [Contractor/Supplier/Employee Full Name or Company Name], located at [Contractor/Supplier Address] ("Party").

1. DEFINITION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION

For the purposes of this Agreement, "confidential information" shall refer to research results, software created, devices produced by the Company, business strategies, financial data, customer details, and any other information deemed proprietary or not generally known to the public.

2. CONFIDENTIALITY

Party agrees not to disclose, use, or allow the use of the Company's confidential information, as defined herein, during or after the relationship, except as required for their services to the Company. This confidentiality obligation lasts for [X years, e.g., "5 years"] from the date of disclosure.

3. NON-COMPETITION

For [X years, e.g., "3 years"] following the termination of their business relationship, Party agrees not to engage in or start any business that directly competes with Company within a [X mile/km radius, e.g., "50-mile radius"] of Company's primary business location. Additionally, if Party is a contractor, they will not provide similar services to any entity competing with the Company within a 50-mile radius of any Company location for 12 months post-relationship.

4. NON-SOLICITATION

For 12 months post-relationship, Party won't solicit or induce any entity or individual connected to the Company to cease or reduce their relationship with the Company.

5. RETURN OF PROPERTY

Upon relationship termination or on Company's request, Party will immediately return or destroy all Company property, including all items containing or pertaining to confidential information and confirm its deletion in writing.

6. PENALTY FOR BREACH

In the event of a breach of this Agreement, Party shall pay the Company a penalty of [specific amount, e.g., "$50,000"].

7. GOVERNING LAW

This Agreement is governed by [State, e.g., "California" or "the State of New York"] laws.

8. ENTIRE AGREEMENT

This Agreement supersedes prior discussions and agreements between the parties and replaces all previous understandings. Any changes to this agreement must be in writing and signed by both parties.

9. SPECIAL TERMS FOR EMPLOYEES

Should Party be an employee who agrees to receive specialized training at no cost from the Company, they commit to work for the company for a specified period. If the employee leaves the company within two years after completing training, they must pay [specific amount, e.g., "$50,000"] as compensation for training costs, payable within 30 days of termination. Exceptions to this repayment include termination without cause, resignation due to breach of agreement by the Company, or other agreed upon circumstances.

10. AGREEMENT ACKNOWLEDGEMENT

By signing below, the parties agree to these terms and acknowledge that this Agreement is binding to all involved parties and their successors. Any breach of this Agreement may result in legal remedies being sought by the Company, including injunction.
